rule: An alt string describes what the picture shows and states what it is not. It is derived from the role the Owner's own catalog assigns in Appendix A of the Master Specification, and from the Arabic manifest that shipped with the generated set. No string here asserts a date, an issuer, a maker, a site, a provenance or an inventory fact, because those remain unverified.
sources: reference/Noujoude_Master_Specification_EN.md — Appendix A rows 1-82 (role and association columns, transcribed into docs/ASSET_INVENTORY_AUDIT.csv column 14)
Noujoude.photo/GENERATED_ASSETS_MANIFEST_AR.md — the EN and AR alt drafts the manifest authored for the ten generated files, adopted verbatim
decorativeUse: A row marked decorative is intended to be painted as a CSS background through the gated /api/media URL, where it carries no alt text at all. The strings below exist for the day one of them is placed in a content slot instead.

unlabelled.rule: Any register row absent from this list keeps Alt Text Status = Not Recorded, and src/lib/media/slot.ts will refuse to draw it. That refusal is the correct state for an image nobody has described.
